about: The order of the folder list (T12.45): case folded, Latin letters with a diacritic sorted with their base letters (core's Whisper-normaliser table, fold_diacritic), ties by the case-folded name, everything else by code point; no language collation. crates/earshot-runtime (folders_tests.rs) creates each case's folders in the order given and lists them through `folders::list`; packages/ui/src/ipc/mockFolders.test.ts sorts them with the mock's `folderOrder`. Every name is invented.
